formalExit.completionRule: Complete only when every one of the Phase 1 exit gates the owner's scope decision keeps in the count passes. On 2026-09-26 the owner removed the raw-file archive recovery gate; no archive or recovery proof is claimed.

gates.requirement: 100 percent of production datasets have a complete ledger entry.
gates.reason: Every one of the 18 core rows has every required ledger field, verified by a JSON-pointer binding (the four reserve and treaty rows were withdrawn by the owner's 2026-09-26 scope decision). Fields completed on 2026-09-26 bind to data/phase1-ledger-facts-2026-09-26.json, whose publisher facts come from each publisher's catalogue record. Production admission is separate and remains 2/18: a complete ledger entry is not an admission.

gates.requirement: The coverage geometry layer exists and covers all four provinces with a grade for every part of the land base.
gates.reason: The machine-checked coverage-admission record directly verifies graded coverage across British Columbia, Alberta, Ontario and Quebec while retaining its non-production boundaries.

gates.requirement: The validation suite fails a deliberately corrupted test dataset.
gates.reason: The synthetic corruption corpus is run in CI and asserts rejection for every listed corruption case.
